brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust, as outlined in SOP-015. Maintain a minimum clearance of two metres between any growth and the radiator face and one metre between growth and the compound fence line per SOP-011. Reduce the permissible load using the ambient de-rating and reduced-cooling rules in MG-021 if reference conditions or cooling capacity are not met.
